en: You know the basketball player Lee Hyun-jung?
He just won gold and is going for the NBA.
His mother, Sung Jung-a, was an amazing player.
In 1984, Korea's women's team
won an Olympic silver medal.
She was on that team as a high school senior.
An Olympic medalist, so her son ranks below her.
She won Asian Games gold too.
A legend among legends.
When her son won gold, she gave an interview.
Which do you prefer, "basketball legend"
or "Lee Hyun-jung's mom"?
Which do you think?
Lee Hyun-jung's mom, of course.
"I'm proud of him."

text:
자기 아들이 슛 넣으면
다 *들어갈* 것 같다
en: Every shot her son takes, she feels it'll go in,
and she just hopes he doesn't get hurt.
That's what she said.
Love God a little more deeply, and
God, too, has hopes for His kingdom,

text:
*기대*를 하고 계시다는 것을
알 수 있습니다
en: and we can see it:
"Through you, I will build my kingdom.

text:
연약하지만 너를 통해
그 일을 *이룰* 것이다
en: You are weak, but through you I'll do it.

text:
내가 너의 *아버지*
내가 너의 하나님인 것을
en: I am your Father, I am your God,
and I am not ashamed of it."
That love is what drives us.
